title: Sprint data: completed tasks grouped into one-week sprints aligned to the Claude weekly usage reset

requirements.text: A genlock command lists tasks completed in a sprint (current or any past one) and in an arbitrary date range
requirements.check: genlock run with current, a past sprint, and a custom range returns the right done tasks

requirements.text: Sprint boundaries follow the Claude weekly reset day and time, set in one config value
requirements.check: file: the config value and a test showing boundaries computed from it

requirements.text: The bridge and Mac app can fetch the same report data
requirements.check: test hits the bridge endpoint and gets the sprint report

evidence: genlock sprint (current) -> 24 tasks done in agent-genlock; genlock sprint --all -1 -> 104 tasks, 1 goal across projects; tests/sprint.mjs picker test: current=2026-11-12, previous=2026-11-05, -3=2026-10-22, date 2026-10-30 -> sprint 2026-10-29, --from/--to range; report test keeps only done tasks in [start,end) — 7/7 pass

mobile/bridge/test/sprint.test.mjs: sprintReport(home) deepEquals genlock sprint --all --json on a real fixture repo with one done task (totals.tasks=1, name Widget); e2e.test.mjs over local wrangler relay: phone sends kind:'sprint' previous -> report.range.offset -1, 12 picker sprints; bad selector -> error. bridge suite 45/45 pass

text: Until TJ answers Q-RCEXE, sprints are cut at mon 00:00 machine-local and every report carries reset.confirmed=false
breaks: Counts per sprint shift once the real reset is set; nothing stored depends on the boundary, so only displays change

text: lib/sprint.mjs + genlock sprint [sel|--from/--to] [--all] [--json] [--set-reset]; config = weekly_reset in <app home>/sprint.json. Bridge kind:'sprint' runs the same CLI. Req 1,3 proved; req 2 waits on TJ's reset day/time (Q-RCEXE). Uncommitted.
Sprints start at the Claude weekly reset, fri 03:00 UTC, matching the server's resets_at

evidence: ~/Library/Application Support/Genlock/sprint.json weekly_reset='fri 03:00 UTC' (TJ chose it; matches usage-api-last.json seven_day.resets_at 2026-11-20T03:00Z). tests/sprint.mjs: boundaries from the setting (thu 17:00 LA -> 2026-11-13T01:00Z; fri 03:00 UTC -> 03:00Z, labelled Nov 12–19 Eastern), reset-instant edge, DST tiling, --set-reset writes/refuses. 7/7 pass

answers.observed: genlock sprint --all: current Nov 12–19 9 done, -1 275 done; bridge sprintReport deepEquals CLI; Swift decode equals bridge
answers.absence: Not proved that Anthropic's reset stays at 03:00 UTC across a DST change; only one resets_at reading
answers.assumption: Reset fixed in UTC (TJ chose this); if it is pinned to US local time it drifts an hour in March
answers.falsify: usage-api-last.json resets_at after March 8 2027 reads 02:00Z instead of 03:00Z
